user.title: Home Island
user.description: Choose the iOS Companion App devices that receive your activities. Requires Core 2026.7+, iOS 17.2+, and a current Companion App. Test on your iPhone before replacing existing automations. Away from home, your phone must reach this Home Assistant server for the Live Activity token handshake.

recipients.title: Recipient devices
recipients.description: Choose notify.mobile_app_* actions for your iOS Companion devices. Known Android registrations are excluded; verify any unrecognized device before selecting it.

basic.title: Activity  -  entity and preset (1 of 5)
basic.description: Choose an entity and a native Companion presentation. Companion controls the Lock Screen and Dynamic Island layout.

lifecycle.title: Activity  -  start and completion (2 of 5)
lifecycle.description: Use the entity's raw state values, including capitalization. Default states are suggestions; adjust them for your appliance. For timer entities, active starts and idle completes.

presentation.title: Activity  -  appearance (3 of 5)
presentation.description: Colors apply where Companion supports them; Dynamic Island keeps system styling. Optional gauge thresholds use a YAML/JSON list of {value: 80, color: '#4CAF50'}. The critical severity label changes styling only; it does not send an Apple Critical Alert.

sources.title: Activity  -  progress and countdown (4 of 5)
sources.description: Leave an entity blank to read its attribute from the monitored entity. A timer automatically uses finishes_at while active. Remaining time accepts seconds or H:MM:SS; ETA accepts a timestamp. Steps uses the progress source as the current step.

timing.title: Activity  -  update and completion policy (5 of 5)
timing.description: Updates are event driven. A 60-second minimum and 5 percentage-point threshold reduce notification use; start, status, and completion changes remain important. Keep leaves the completion visible until platform expiration; dismiss sends clear_notification after the delay.

toggle.title: Enable or disable an activity
toggle.description: Select an activity to toggle its enabled state. Disabled activities are not monitored.

remove.title: Remove an activity
remove.description: Select an activity to remove its tracker. This does not change the monitored entity or your automations.

test.title: Test an activity
test.description: Send a short-lived preview to the configured recipients. Physical display and delivery must be verified on your iPhone.
